note: The eleven ambiguity families of F-153. Ten of them put a plausible distraction in front of the engine and ask it to decline; the eleventh puts the person's actual work in front of it and asks the same, because a suite that cannot fail on THAT is a suite that certifies the engine's most dangerous output. Every family names the code path that produces its answer, so a fixture cannot pass for the wrong reason the day the engine changes, and every family carries at least one negative control — a near-identical case that DOES resolve — so the suite proves the engine is discriminating rather than merely timid. Family 11 carries three obligations no other family does: dwell triples on both sides of sustainedDriftThreshold, negative controls in both directions, and one case per negativeBasisKinds member plus the two excluded kinds.
